entries.title: Hebrews 8:1
segments: Now in the things which we are saying the chief point [is this]: We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

entries.title: Hebrews 8:2
segments: a minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:3
segments: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is necessary that this [high priest] also have somewhat to offer.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:4
segments: Now if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are those who offer the gifts according to the law;

entries.title: Hebrews 8:5
segments: who serve [that which is] a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses is warned [of God] when he is about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern that was showed thee in the mount.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:6
segments: But now hath he obtained a ministry the more excellent, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which hath been enacted upon better promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:7
segments: For if that first [covenant] had been faultless, then would no place have been sought for a second.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:8
segments: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, That I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

entries.title: Hebrews 8:9
segments: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers In the day that I took them by the hand to lead them forth out of the land of Egypt; For they continued not in my covenant, And I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:10
segments: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel After those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, And on their heart also will I write them: And I will be to them a God, And they shall be to me a people:

entries.title: Hebrews 8:11
segments: And they shall not teach every man his fellow-citizen, And every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: For all shall know me, From the least to the greatest of them.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:12
segments: For I will be merciful to their iniquities, And their sins will I remember no more.

entries.title: Hebrews 8:13
segments: In that he saith, A new [covenant] he hath made the first old. But that which is becoming old and waxeth aged is nigh unto vanishing away.
